name: Simulishan horumarsan
panel.honest: Daraasado aan khad ahayn iyo xidhiidh ee daraasadda Simulation ee qaybtan. Waa caawiye falanqeed injineer ah, ma aha ansixin naqshadeed: hubi tirooyinka xisaabta gacanta ama barnaamij kale.
part.heading: Qaybtan
part.no_study: Qaybtan wali ma lahan daraasad Simulation. Dooro nooca daraasadda hoose si aad u bilowdo, kadibna deji agabka, taageerada iyo culeysyada goobta Simulation.
part.need_bcs: Taageerada iyo culeysyada waxaa lagu doortaa dusha goobta Simulation. Tabkan wuxuu hayaa kuwa daraasaddu leedahay.
type.heading: Nooca daraasadda
type.note: Aan khad ahayn: agabku wuxuu raacaa khad toosan ilaa xadka dhalinta, kadibna jiifka ka yar. Xidhiidh: isla agabka, iyo qaybo qaybta ka mid ah oo isku riixaya. Labaduba waxay hayaan taageerada, culeysyada iyo agabka daraasadda.
nl.et_note: Ka tag jiifka madhan si aad u hesho 1 % ee E ({E} MPa). 0 waxay ka dhigan tahay plastik sida ay tahay: culeyska xadka ka dib tallaabooyinka ma isku uruurin, natiijadna way sheegaysaa.
pairs.heading: Lammaanaha xidhiidhka
pairs.one_piece: Qaybtu waa hal qayb. Xidhiidhku wuxuu u baahan yahay laba qaybood ama ka badan oo kala go'an (tusaale, laba leeg oo sawir-gacmeed hal mid ah ku jira, oo la soo jiidey).
pairs.none: Dusha toosan ee qaybaha kala duwan ee isku wajahan ma jiro gudaha {gap} mm.
pairs.found_one: {a} iyo {b}: {gap} mm ka fog, {area} mm² isku dhac
pairs.empty: Weli lammaane ma jiro. Raadi dusha taabanaysa, ama ku dar lammaane goobta Simulation oo dooro dusheeda halkaas.
pairs.note: Xidhiidhku waa aan jiid lahayn ama isku xidhan; natiijooyinka habka ganaaxa waxay leeyihiin gal-ku-dhaca la sheegay; isticmaal CalculiX jiidh iyo dhaqdhaqaaq weyn.
pair.name: Lammaane {n}: dhinaca A {a}, dhinaca B {b}
run.heading: Socodsii
res.heading: Natiijada
res.ccx_disp: {n} qanjaro; faylka ma jiro istireenno (kala-guurka oo keliya)
res.converged: Wuxuu isku uruuriyay {steps} tallaabo oo culeys ah
res.failed: Waa istaagay: tallaabada ilaa {at} % ee culeyska ma isku uruurin; {done} % ayaa la xisaabiyay
res.vm.k: Xoogga von Mises ee ugu weyn
res.plastic: Ugu weyn {e} ({pct} %), jiifka ka dib dhalinta {Et} MPa
res.elastic: Ma jiro: agabku wuxuu sii joogay elastik
res.pen.over: {p} mm, {pct} % ee unugga {h} mm: wuxuu ka badan yahay 1 %, kor u qaad qiimaha ganaaxa
plot.label: Plot
plot.shown: Xariiqyada midabka la dhigay: {n}, qaybta dhinacyada ku taal, qaab × {scale}. Waa jidh muuqaal ah: ma leh miisaan, lama dhoofin.
plot.none: Natiijadan ma jiro wax lagu plot-gareeyo.
plot.too_big: Plot-ka wuxuu leeyahay {n} saddex-geesood, oo ka badan 60,000 oo ay viewport-ku kordhinta ka aqbali karo. Isticmaal plot-ka goobta Simulation.
plot.legend: Buluug {lo} ilaa casaan {hi} {unit}; qaabka waxaa lagu muujiyay {scale} jeer kala-guurkiisa dhabta ah.
plot.note: Plot-ka buuxa oo leh baaritaano, daraasadda isla markaana xisaabi goobta Simulation: waa daraasadda qaybtan.
ccx.heading: CalculiX
ccx.never_run: Faylalka CalculiX waxaa loo qoray sida buugga gacanta CalculiX, mana loo socodsiin CalculiX. Ka filo inaad fayl-ka koowaad gacanta ku hagaajiso, oo faylka .log ee fayl fashilmay u dir CadCraft.
ccx.note: CalculiX waa barnaamij kale oo aad rakibto oo aad socodsiiso adiga; halkan waxba ma socodsiiyo. Ku akhri .frd isla qaybtaas adigoo daraasadda beddelin, bal shabaqu ma isku habboonaan doono.
ccx.written: Faylka CalculiX waa la kaydiyay: {n} qanjaro, {e} unug (weligood lama socodsiin CalculiX).
ccx.read: Natiijooyinka CalculiX waa la akhriyay: {n} qanjaro, kala-guurka ugu weyn {d} mm.
ccx.deck_head:
Waxaa qoray kordhinta Simulation horumarsan ee PartCraft (CadCraft). Unugyada: mm, N, MPa, tonne.
LAMA HUBIN CALCULIX: faylalka PartCraft weligood lama socodsiin CalculiX. Hubi faylka ka hor intaanad isku halayn natiijadiisa.
why.no_study: Qaybtan ma leh daraasad Simulation. Marka hore dooro Aan khad ahayn ama Xidhiidh.
why.not_nl: Daraasaddu ma aha mid aan khad ahayn ama xidhiidh. Marka hore dooro Aan khad ahayn ama Xidhiidh.
why.tet_only: Daraasadaha aan khad ahayn iyo xidhiidhka waxay u baahan yihiin shabaqa tetrahedral.
why.nothing: Wax la xisaabiyo weli ma jiro: qaybta weli lama dhisin.

msg.found_none: Dusha isku wajahan ma la helin.
